'''''Kenobi''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel that tells the story of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'s first [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] in self-[[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] following the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. It was written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and first published by [[Del Rey]] in hardcover on [[August 27]], [[2013]]. The first paperback edition was released on [[July 29]], [[2014]] and includes the short tie-in story "[[Incognito]]" by Miller.
